# Raghav Mahajan — raghv.dev

> Personal site of Raghav Mahajan, a web developer and SOC analyst in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. He builds secure websites and web apps for small businesses, works in security operations, and publishes the Blue Team Brief cybersecurity newsletter.

Website: https://www.raghv.dev/
Contact: hello@raghv.dev
Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

## Professional focus

- SOC analysis and security operations
- Blue team monitoring and detection
- Wazuh SIEM in a four-node home lab
- Linux system administration
- Active Directory and Windows Server
- Network security and packet analysis
- Python security automation
- Web application security
- Full-stack web development for small businesses

## Evidence policy

Lab-generated activity on this site is labelled as lab activity. Historical captures are distinguished from live telemetry, and simulated displays are labelled simulated. Certification dates should be taken from the Certifications page and employment dates from the Experience page; those pages are the source of truth.
